title: NSE IPO Review: 'Highly attractive' - Subscribe for long-term, says Raj Gaikar of SAMCO Securities
text: NSE IPO Review: 'Highly attractive' - Subscribe for long-term, says Raj Gaikar of SAMCO Securities. Considering its leadership, financial strength, high margins, debt-free balance sheet and structural capital-market growth, SAMCO Securities recommends subscribing to the IPO for the long term.
